resolvableVersionedIdentifiers.basis: Remote canonical publication verification reports PASS for every catalogued v0.9.0 schema and requires the resolved URL to equal the canonical identifier.

checksumVerification.basis: The v0.9.1 reproducible package binds declared source artifacts with SHA-256 checksums while preserving the v0.9.0 normative baseline.

historicalVersionRetention.basis: The current v0.9.1 publication verification resolves and byte-compares versioned /v0.9.0/ schema identifiers after the subsequent maintenance release, demonstrating retained historical publication across a release boundary.

limitations: This is evidence of current historical retention across the v0.9.0 to v0.9.1 release boundary, not a claim of indefinite hosting durability.
Future publication or hosting changes can invalidate this evidence and require reassessment.
reassessmentTriggers: historical version route becomes unavailable or redirects to a different canonical URL
checksum algorithm or release packaging changes materially

decision.reason: All three required evidence predicates are now represented by reproducible repository evidence, with durability claims explicitly bounded.
